subject: Re: MAP draft & updated timeline for Acme Healthcare POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft and post-call recap — Acme Healthcare POC

Hi Emily / Raj —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment. I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the POC. Please review and flag anything missing.

Key outcomes from the call:
- Scope: 1-week POC (inference perf + cost benchmarking) focused on clinical search use-case
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 200ms for 512-token flows; cost/unit < $0.05 per 1k tokens during steady-state
- Stakeholders: Emily (Product), Raj (IT), Procurement (Procurement)

Proposed MAP (attached: MAP_AcmeHealthcare_v1.xlsx) — highlights:
1) Kickoff & environment access — Responsibility: Acme (Raj) / Redwood (Marissa) — target: 2025-06-17
2) Test dataset handoff — Responsibility: Acme (Emily) — target: 2025-06-19
3) POC execution & baseline runs — Responsibility: Redwood (Dylan) — target: 2025-06-23
4) Results review & decision — Responsibility: Acme/Redwood — target close: 2025-06-30

Dependencies: procurement approval for test account, network/VPC peering (if private), SOC 2 evidence request for security review.

Next steps:
- Emily/Raj: review MAP and confirm responsibilities or propose changes by EOD Mon 6/16
- Redwood: hold internal prep and reserve a POC window w/ Dedicated capacity (Dylan)
- Schedule 30-min results review week of 6/30

Phone if helpful: +1 (415) 555-0134

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: MAP_AcmeHealthcare_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and post-call recap — Acme Healthcare POC

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligned with our conversation. A couple notes from our side:

- Procurement and our finance cycle means we likely can't complete contracting until mid-July. Can we move the target close to 2025-07-15?
- SOC 2 evidence is required for our security review — I attached our SOC checklist (Acme_SOC2_Reqs.pdf).
- Priorities: procurement -> security review -> POC execution. If procurement is delayed, we may need to run a limited sandbox run that doesn't require procurement approval.

I confirmed Raj will coordinate with Procurement and loop them in. We'll review the MAP and get back with any edits by next Tue 6/17.

Best,
Emily
Director of Product, Acme Healthcare
emily.jones@acmehealth.com

Attachment: Acme_SOC2_Reqs.pdf (PDF)

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Jones <emily.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Acme Healthcare - Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and post-call recap — Acme Healthcare POC

Adding Procurement to this thread. A couple clarifications:

- Procurement will need a clear milestone for contract signature and a final target close date. Given our internal budget approvals, assume earliest contract signature is end of July.
- Security will run SOC 2 evidence review — target window for that review: 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-10.
- If we need to push the commercial close, please reforecast the MAP accordingly.

For Redwood: please add the procurement contact (procurement@acmehealth.com) to the MAP and include a line item for contract review and signature.

—Raj
VP IT, Acme Healthcare
raj.patel@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP (v1.1) + reforecasted timeline — Acme Healthcare POC

Emily / Raj —

Thanks for the quick responses and for looping Procurement, Raj. Based on your notes I updated the MAP (attached: MAP_AcmeHealthcare_v1.1.xlsx) and reforecasted the target close. Summary of changes: 

- Reforecasted target close: 2025-07-31 (was 2025-06-30) to align with procurement and SOC 2 review windows
- New milestone: Contract review & signature — Responsibility: Acme Procurement / Redwood Legal — target: 2025-07-24
- SOC 2 evidence handoff & review — Responsibility: Redwood (Stephanie)/Acme Security — target window: 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-10
- Reordered milestones so procurement + security are gated before POC execution.

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm Procurement owner and preferred contract template by 6/20
- Confirm whether a sandbox (non-production) POC is acceptable before procurement completes (if you want to accelerate testing)

Action items for Redwood:
- Stephanie: prepare SOC 2 artifact pack and a short security checklist for Acme by 6/25
- Dylan: hold POC capacity slot for week of 7/21 (tentative)
- Marissa: update HubSpot with reforecast and upload MAP v1.1

Next meeting suggestion: 30-min alignment call w/ Procurement + Security the week of 7/7. Are you available?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: MAP_AcmeHealthcare_v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 10:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP (v1.1) + reforecasted timeline — Acme Healthcare POC

Marissa / team —

I reviewed the updated MAP and the proposed reforecast. Approve moving target close to 2025-07-31, but flagging commercial risk given procurement timeline. Suggest we:

- Move POC execution out to week of 7/28 to give SOC 2 review buffer (change Dylan's tentative slot to 7/28)
- Prepare a brief executive one-pager that frames value & ROI for Procurement to help speed review — Marissa, can you draft?
- If Procurement pushes beyond 7/31, escalate for a one-time pilot discount approval (we'll want to keep margin visibility)

Please update HubSpot deal stage to "Contracting" and set the expected close date to 2025-08-05 to reflect risk.

Thanks — open to a quick sync if helpful.

Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
